objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing policies, guidelines, work instructions, or other regulatory content that undergoes creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving with version control and audit trails

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level such as code of conduct, travel expenses policy, or ICS policy

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing detailed procedural steps and special work steps that are usually relevant for specific departments

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type that describes specific procedures and process sequences with details and responsible persons to achieve objectives

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document, such as brief instructions, photos or screenshots

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled supplementary object attached to a document that is subject to the release cycle of the main document and triggers new versions when created, modified or archived

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting the content or version history of the original document

objs.name: user
objs.description: A system user with specific roles and authorizations in document management

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific access rights and roles for document management

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and editing documents with read and write permissions on document details

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with additional personal change rights to a document alongside the primary author

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving documents and deciding whether to distribute them to readers

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with permission to view approved documents only

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released content into other languages

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A designated user group with read access to archived documents when all other authorizations have been revoked

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review document validity and decide whether to extend, revise or invalidate the document

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request created to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate previously invalidated documents and restore their active status

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons assigned to receive specific documents through email notification or acknowledgement workflow

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A category or classification of documents with associated attributes, templates and document properties

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined structure or format that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific document type

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A specific release iteration of a document with associated status, timestamp and signature documentation

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: A defined group in the system for assigning read and change rights to multiple users or persons for specific documents

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a new document in the system with selection of document type and optional template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or properties after creation

evts.name: upload_content
evts.description: Attachment of external files or documents to a document object

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document content to PDF format after saving

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change rights to users and user groups for a document

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the 3-step approval workflow process by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participants during the Creator, Review, or Release workflow step

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Checking of document content according to technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewers

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approval and publication of document by assigned releasers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document to readers after release

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of a released document with retention of previous version data

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when no longer relevant in new document version

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Addition of supplementary information object to a document outside the release cycle

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of controlled supplementary object to a document subject to the release cycle

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Removal of additional information object from a document

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a proposed amendment to an existing document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Conversion of a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval and extension of document validity period by releaser or through multi-participant workflow

evts.name: update_validity_date
evts.description: Automatic update of Valid Until date when validity is extended

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to declare document invalid and archive it

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as out of force and archiving of all permissions

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate previously invalidated documents

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of previously invalidated document to active status with new version

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Sending of email notification to distribution list upon document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow task sent to distribution list requesting active confirmation of document receipt

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by recipient of acknowledgement workflow task

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Checking of translated document content by assigned participants

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of translated document version

o2o.description: Documents can reference other documents through maintained attributes
Attachments belong to and are subject to the release cycle of a main document
Additional information is supplementary to and released independently of a main document
Change proposals belong to and reference a specific document
Validity extension requests are linked to documents requiring validity review
Override requests are associated with documents to be invalidated
Reactivation requests reference documents that are being reactivated
Document versions represent specific release iterations of a document
Users are members of user groups with assigned roles and access rights
Authors create and have read-write access to documents
Co-authors have personal change rights alongside the primary author
Reviewers are assigned to documents to check technical and formal aspects
Releasers are assigned to documents to approve and distribute them
Readers are assigned to documents through user groups to view approved content
Translators create language versions of released documents
Archive group users retain read access to archived documents
Authorization groups define read and change rights for documents
Distribution lists maintain user groups and persons assigned to specific documents
Document templates are predefined formats for specific document types
Authorization groups can be defined per document type for access control

o2e.description: Documents are created in the system
Documents are edited to modify content or properties
External files or documents are uploaded to document objects
Documents are automatically converted to PDF format
User groups are assigned read and change rights for documents
Users are assigned read and change rights for documents
Authors initiate the approval workflow process
Co-authors can initiate the approval workflow process
Authors sign documents in the Creator workflow step
Reviewers check document content in the Review workflow step
Reviewers sign documents after completing their review
Releasers approve and release documents
Releasers sign documents during the Release workflow step
Documents are automatically published to readers after release
Released documents are revised to create new versions
Attachments are archived when no longer relevant
Additional information objects are created for documents
Attachment objects are created for documents
Additional information is deleted from documents
Change proposals are created for existing documents
Change proposals are implemented as new document versions
Validity extension requests are system-generated for documents
Document validity is extended through approval workflow
Document valid until date is updated when validity is extended
Override requests are created for documents to be invalidated
Documents are declared out of force and archived
Reactivation requests are created for archived documents
Previously invalidated documents are reactivated
Distributions lists trigger email notifications upon document release
Distribution lists trigger acknowledgement workflow tasks
Users confirm acknowledgement of distributed documents
Translators create language versions of documents
Translators or assigned reviewers check translated content
Translated document versions are released for readers
